title: ShiftBench: Benchmarking Robustness to Real Distribution Shift
description:
Collected 40 natural distribution shifts from public image datasets.
Built a leaderboard that re-evaluates models nightly.
Released the benchmark as an open-source Python package.
resume_description: Collected 40 natural distribution shifts and built a nightly-updated robustness leaderboard

title: ShapeCheck: Static Shape Checking for PyTorch
description:
Wrote an abstract interpreter that tracks tensor shapes through PyTorch programs.
Suggests one-line fixes for common shape bugs.
